test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Vihaan and Nav Agarwal won the International Children's Peace Prize 2021 for which work?

options.text: For making an anti-cyberbullying mobile app
For building a school in a refugee camp
For tackling pollution in their home city by recycling household waste
For peaceful fight against extremist violence and radicalisation

solution:
The correct answer is **__For tackling pollution in their home city by recycling household waste__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Two Indian teenage brothers Vihaan and Nav Agrawal have won the 2021 KidsRights International Children's Peace Prize for tackling pollution from household waste.**
 
• Vihaan (17) and Nav Agarwal (14) have **developed the 'One Step Greener' initiative segregating recyclables and organising pickups for trash from thousands of homes.**
 
• From an impressive 169 applicants from 39 countries, the KidsRights’ Expert Committee selected Nav and Vihaan as winners.
 
• They were** awarded by Nobel laureate Kailash Satyarthi.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• 'One Step Greener' initiative 

 
 
• After seeing the** link between waste and air pollution following Delhi’s Ghazipur landfill collapse.** 
 
• Both boys were inspired to create One Step Greener –** an initiative that began segregating rubbish and organizing waste pickup drives.**
 
• **​From just 15 homes, One Step Greener is now a city-wide operation** collecting rubbish from more than 1,000 households, schools, and offices, and has recycled 173,630 kilograms of waste.
 
• **The entrepreneurial brothers often devote 4-5 hours per day** to the organization and are **working to bring their sustainability message to children across India.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• KidsRights International Children's Peace Prize 

 
 
• ​The** prestigious prize was launched in 2005** during the World Summit of Nobel Peace Laureates **in Rome, chaired by Mikhail Gorbachev.**
 
• Since then, the** prize has been presented by a Nobel Peace Prize Laureate every year.**
 
• In 2021 the 17th International Children’s Peace Prize was presented by **Kailash Satyarthi**, **Nobel Peace Prize Laureate 2014**.
 
 

16a:T1
